_comment: Copy this file to qa/local-paths.json (git-ignored) and put the absolute paths of YOUR OWN sample data in it. Nothing naming a real survey, site or job may ever be committed. Every key is optional; an env var (SEISCONV_QA_SEGY / SEISCONV_QA_LE / SEISCONV_QA_SPS, ';'-separated for a list) overrides it, and SEISCONV_QA_DATA_ROOT sets the folder the placeholder defaults resolve under.
_forbiddenTerms_comment: Strings that must never appear in a manual/marketing screenshot: YOUR real survey and site names, YOUR corpus folder names, YOUR machine account name, YOUR employer. They live here, not in the committed source, because the repo is public and a committed denylist would publish exactly what it guards. Each entry is a REGULAR-EXPRESSION SOURCE matched case-insensitively, so remember to double the backslash for JSON; an entry that will not compile stops the run instead of being skipped. SEISCONV_FORBIDDEN_TERMS (';'-separated) overrides this key. The examples below are FAKE placeholders - replace them, never commit a real one. With this key absent the guard still catches drive-letter paths, AppData and an account name inside a path, but knows nothing of your site's vocabulary.
